# Telegram

3 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 3 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

Public Telegram channel data: channel profile, the channel's post feed, and a single post. Private groups and DMs are out of scope and always will be - only public channels are readable.

<!-- BEGIN:GENERATED:ENDPOINTS (auto-generated by generate-docs.ts - AIP-16b) -->

## GET /v1/telegram/post - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one public Telegram post by its t.me URL, including the text, publish time, view count, the per-emoji reaction breakdown, and direct media URLs. View and reaction counts on posts are rounded by Telegram's own public preview, so use them for ranking rather than for exact deltas.

**Use when** you have a single post link and do not want to page the whole channel. View and reaction counts are rounded, so read them as ranking signals rather than exact figures.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Public Telegram post URL, in the form https://t.me/{handle}/{id} · e.g. `https://t.me/durov/546`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+11 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language}; `post.author` {display_name}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, media_urls, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {likes, views}; `post.flags` {deleted}; `post.ext` {reaction_counts}.

**Next** `telegram/profile/posts` (`handle` ← `data.post.author.username`) - List Telegram channel posts. · `telegram/profile` (`handle` ← `data.post.author.username`) - Get Telegram channel profile.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/telegram/post" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://t.me/durov/546" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/telegram/profile - 1 credit (standard)

Returns a public Telegram channel or group profile including its display name, description, avatar URL, verification status, and subscriber count. The subscriber count is exact rather than abbreviated. Private channels, invite-only groups, and channels with no public preview return 404.

**Use when** you have a handle and want the channel snapshot, or to confirm a channel is public before paging its posts.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Public Telegram handle, with or without the leading @, or a t.me channel URL · e.g. `telegram`

**Response** `Author` object at `data`, `{ author, computed }` ([full schema](schemas/Author.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.username` | User handle or username |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |

+6 more (types in the full schema): `author` {followers, verified}; `computed` {content_category, engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/telegram/profile" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=telegram" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/telegram/profile/posts - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one page of recent public posts from a Telegram channel or group, newest page first. Each post carries its text, publish time, view count, the per-emoji reaction breakdown, and direct media URLs for photos and videos. Pass the returned cursor to walk further back through the channel's history. Page size varies because photo albums count as one post and service messages are skipped, so a short page does not mean the end of the channel: keep paging until the cursor is absent.

**Use when** you want to read or archive a channel's history. Page size varies, so keep passing the cursor until it comes back empty rather than stopping on a short page.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** cursor · ≈20/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/20) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `handle` (required) - Public Telegram handle, with or without the leading @, or a t.me channel URL · e.g. `telegram`
- `cursor` (optional, string) - Cursor from the previous page's pagination block. Omit it for the most recent posts.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |

+11 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {engagement_rate, estimated_reach, language}; `post.author` {display_name}; `post.content` {duration_seconds, media_urls, thumbnail_url}; `post.engagement` {likes, views}; `post.flags` {deleted}; `post.ext` {reaction_counts}. Also in the sample: `post.author` {avatar_url null, verified null}; `post.engagement` {comments null, shares null, saves null}; `post.flags` {nsfw null, spoiler null, pinned null}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `telegram/post` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get Telegram post.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/telegram/profile/posts" \
  --data-urlencode "handle=telegram" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
